integrity: The universal statement is proved by an exhaustive prime-exponent split and an exact Euler-product bound. The finite checker is corroborative only. The earliest public source date is the v1 arXiv posting on 2026-09-27; the scientific text inspected is the current v2. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes integer \(k\ge2\). It classifies the maximal open parameter interval containing \(t=0\) and \(t=1\), not every disconnected real parameter value outside that interval. It is structural rather than an efficient primality test.
title: Sharp parameter stability for mixed Dirichlet-inverse prime criteria
